description: Create a professional client proposal document with three distinct pricing tiers. The document should include: (1) a proposal title or heading, (2) three clearly labeled tiers with different names (e.g., Basic/Standard/Premium or Tier 1/2/3), (3) pricing for each tier with dollar amounts, (4) deliverables or description for each tier, and (5) professional formatting using tables or lists. Save the document as /home/ga/Documents/TextDocuments/client_proposal.docx
